definitions.explanation: The relationship between cost and quality/benefit. Short for コストパフォーマンス.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}はコスパがいいです。
examples.english: This restaurant offers good value for money.

examples.japanese: コスパを{考|かんが}えると、こちらの{方|ほう}がおすすめです。
examples.english: Considering the value, I recommend this one.

examples.japanese: コスパ{最高|さいこう}の{商品|しょうひん}を{見|み}つけました。
examples.english: I found a product with the best value for money.

notes: Abbreviation of コストパフォーマンス (cost performance). Very common in everyday conversation, especially when discussing purchases or services. Usually used with が{良|い}い/が{悪|わる}い. Contrasts with タイパ (time-performance).
